name: segmented-telemetry-roundtrip
source: built by tools/gen/sdls-ep-vectors.py from values chosen there; layout restated from CCSDS 524.1-B-1 sections 3.1 and 3.4 and CCSDS 133.0-B-2 section 4.1.3; the first segment of a telemetry error message: a negative transaction ID, the segment counter, and the timestamp and body as octets; expect derived there, no engine run
